{"metadata":{"description":"Run multi-agent task pipelines on DSH like a team — plan, execute, review, and deliver code through a visual kanban with provable completion.","id":"gh:1340258211","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-swarm","slug":"joekytc/dsh-swarm","topics":["agent-orchestration","ai-agents","cordis","deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin","event-sourcing","kanban","multi-agent","task-management","typescript"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Run multi-agent task pipelines on DSH like a team — plan, execute, review, and deliver code through "},{"id":"p1s2","text":"a visual kanban with provable completion."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-swarm"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"简体中文 · English"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"**Say one requirement, reply one confirmation — six specialist agents take it from planning to verif"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"ied delivery. No commands to memorize.**"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"dsh-swarm is a DSH plugin that turns one requirement into a strict, evidence-verified delivery pipel"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"ine. An orchestrator (V) decomposes an approved spec into a strictly ordered phase chain (`p → (pt?)"},{"id":"p5s3","text":" → w2 → d → dt → w3 → summary`); six single-purpose roles (V / P / W / D / PT / DT) run each phase w"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"ith isolated, permission-gated tool faces; every handoff is machine-verified against an evidence con"},{"id":"p5s5","text":"tract; failures recover through idempotent retry and human-gated reviews; and a live Workflow kanban"},{"id":"p5s6","text":" tab streams all state to the browser via SSE. Design inspired by the Hermes Agent kanban."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Swarm mode (recommended)"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"Swarm mode turns your main session into a **team lead**: **you state the requirement, it clarifies, "},{"id":"p7s2","text":"plans, confirms, delegates and follows through** — entirely in natural language, no commands to reme"},{"id":"p7s3","text":", confirms, delegates and follows through** — entirely in natural language, no commands to remember."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- **No commands to memorize** — just state your requirement; no `/plan:` or `/openspec:` prefixes ne"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"eded.
- **Automatic intent recognition** — development requests → clarify/plan and build a chain; le"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"ssons & retrospectives → persist to memory; group notifications → deliver to WeCom; Q&A; / chit-chat"},{"id":"p8s4","text":" → answered directly. Intent is judged by the model, not by a code-level classifier — the confirmati"},{"id":"p8s5","text":"on gate below is what stops a misjudged chain.
- **Free delivery** — `/sms <intent>` (e.g. "post cur"},{"id":"p8s6","text":"rent progress to the group"): facts are grounded via kanban lookup, then the body is composed per in"},{"id":"p8s7","text":"tent and delivered; `-s` or wording like "private chat" targets the DM. A bare `/sms` re-sends the l"},{"id":"p8s8","text":"atest completed-chain report and `/sms blocked [chainId]` the block notice — those two bodies are re"},{"id":"p8s9","text":"ndered by system code from kanban facts, never rewritten by the lead. Group and private-chat targets"},{"id":"p8s10","text":" auto-resolve to the single saved target (0 or 2+ targets error out; clean up in dsh-im settings, or"},{"id":"p8s11","text":" pin `imDelivery.targetId` / `imDelivery.dmTargetId`, which skips the count check — though with `imD"},{"id":"p8s12","text":"elivery.botId` empty the pinned target must still belong to the auto-discovered bot, or it errors ou"},{"id":"p8s13","text":"t).
- **Confirmation gate against accidental chains** — after the checklist is saved, the lead is in"},{"id":"p8s14","text":"structed to build a chain only once you reply with an explicit affirmative (`确认` / `开干` / `开跑` / `开始"},{"id":"p8s15","text":"` / `go`, etc.). The gate is judged by the model, not enforced by a code-level check; vague replies,"},{"id":"p8s16","text":" topic switches, or edit-only feedback count as *not confirmed*.
- **The lead is read-only** — the m"},{"id":"p8s17","text":"ain session cannot write/edit repo sources, nor run git mutations (push/commit/reset…); a bare `git "},{"id":"p8s18","text":"checkout`/`git switch` of an existing branch is allowed. Writing code is done by the executor (D) in"},{"id":"p8s19","text":" an isolated workspace by design.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"### Why it's designed this way"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Coordinating several agents on one task typically fails in three ways:"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"- **Role drift** — the "planner" starts writing code, the "executor" reviews its own work, and nobod"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"y owns the outcome.
- **Unverifiable handoffs** — an agent claims "done" with no reproducible eviden"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"ce, and the next agent builds on sand.
- **Silent deadlocks** — an agent stops without finishing and"},{"id":"p11s4","text":" the pipeline hangs, or bad code is merged before anyone reviewed it."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"dsh-swarm encodes a *contract* against all three: one responsibility per role, enforced by the permi"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"ssion matrix, tool faces and task-body instructions;
every handoff must carry structured evidence or"},{"id":"p12s3","text":" the phase will not close; every stall or review
failure lands in a visible, recoverable state — wit"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"h you (the human) as the final trust anchor.
It is built correctness-first: deterministic state mach"},{"id":"p12s5","text":"ines, append-only event sourcing, idempotent
schedulers, and a red-team test suite that replays the "},{"id":"p12s6","text":"event log and rejects any illegal transition
(mechanics in Advanced)."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"### Two modes"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"| Mode | How you use it | Notes |"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"| **Swarm mode** (recommended) | Just say the requirement in natural language | No commands to memor"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"ize, intent auto-recognized, runs on confirmation |
| **Command mode** (compatible) | `/plan: <requi"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"rement>` → clarify → `/openspec: confirm` | Kept for compatibility, functionally equivalent; may be "},{"id":"p15s4","text":"removed in the future — new users should use swarm mode |"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## Quickstart"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"### 1. Install"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Prerequisites: a working DSH runtime (`@deepseek-ai/*`), Node.js ≥ 22.19 and npm. Optional: a wiki-v"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"ault HTTP service (KB features, see Configuration)."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"From npm (the published tarball ships the built `lib/`):"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## What it does for you"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"Six roles, one job each — boundaries enforced by the permission matrix, trimmed tool faces and task-"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"body instructions, so no role creep:"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"| Role | One-line responsibility | What it never does |"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"| **V** Orchestrator | Creates phase cards, drives the pipeline, gives guidance on stalls | Never ex"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"ecutes |
| **P** Planner | Reads the spec + repo facts, writes the implementation plan | Never write"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"s code |
| **PT** Plan reviewer | Read-only review of P's plan (on demand) | Never changes anything "},{"id":"p24s4","text":"|
| **W** Knowledge officer | Syncs the KB in planning/completion phases | Never touches code/git |
"},{"id":"p24s5","text":"| **D** Executor | The only role that writes code: implement → verify → commit → push feature branch"},{"id":"p24s6","text":" | Never merges into the target branch itself |
| **DT** Implementation reviewer | Empirically verif"},{"id":"p24s7","text":"ies D's delivery (tests/build/typecheck/diff) | Read-only against the repo |"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"The pipeline (strictly serial within a chain, parallel across chains):"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"- `pt` appears only when P decides a plan review is needed; `d` is **always** followed by an impleme"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"ntation review (`dt`).
- Chain completion is decided by a mechanical rule (W3 done + D done with del"},{"id":"p27s3","text":"ivery evidence + no open tasks), not by an agent's self-assessment."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"### Architecture"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"Layers, with the domain layer kept free of **runtime** DSH dependencies (a single
